hook: Read real-format Nutrition Facts labels for 24 everyday snacks and drinks, count the hidden teaspoons of sugar, and crack ten case files by tapping the label line that proves the answer.
outcome: Read a Nutrition Facts label (serving size, servings per container, calories, %DV and the 5/20 rule, added sugars and sodium) and use it to compare foods and choose one that fits a health goal
sources: Label format, Daily Values and rounding: FDA Nutrition Facts label (21 CFR 101.9, 2016 rule)
Nutrient values: typical amounts for generic foods, based on USDA FoodData Central; real brands vary
Added sugar guidance for children: American Heart Association (less than 25 g a day, ages 2-18)
Illustrations generated with Google Gemini, edited for Curio Class
